entries.reason: katex 0.16.47: via mermaid and @lobehub/ui (remark-math); the fix is only in 0.18.2+, which neither accepts.
The fix is only in minimatch 11. 10.2.5 comes in via eslint (lint-time, our own config globs) and Expo build tooling (mobile, our own project files); no untrusted glob patterns.
The crash needs an argument whose toString is not a function; only our own calls reach it.

Via Expo build tooling in the mobile app (@expo/config): runs on the developer machine at build and dev-server time on our own project files, never shipped in the app bundle. glob 14.0.2 (2026-10-27) is a major bump from 13 that Expo does not accept yet; deepmerge has no fix. Re-check on the next Expo SDK bump.

Via Expo build tooling in the mobile app (@expo/cli dev server and code signing): runs on the developer machine on our own project files, never shipped in the app bundle. Fixed in node-forge 1.4.3 (published 2026-11-04), which clears the 14-day minimumReleaseAge on 2026-11-18; then raise the node-forge override in pnpm-workspace.yaml to ^1.4.3 and remove this entry.
